title: Rappal Bounce
style: Alternative R&B and dembow-fused rap at a mid-tempo bounce, with clipped kick-snare, rubbery bass, and playful high-register vocal stacks. Verse rides sparse percussion and quick Russian rap cadences; pre-chorus lifts with filtered claps and call-response chants; chorus snaps open with gang vocals and handclap hooks. Brushed ad-libs, pitch-bent ear candy, glossy yet gritty mix., rap, latin, bounce, alternative r&b
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
esktimo on the block, I slide in clean
clap-clap step, make the whole room lean
rappal.app, yeah, I said it like that
rap back, pal, rap back, make it bounce right back

You got that?
I got that
sing it back, pal
then I bring it back

wanna dance, pal, dance
feet move fast
latin america, pal
make the moment last

[Pre-Chorus]
pal dot dance, let it spin
hands up high, let the night begin
song pal song pal dot a i
say it slow, then lift it high

[Chorus]
pal rap back
pal rap back
pal rap back
we go clap and bounce

sing pal dot a i
sing pal dot a i
sing pal dot a i
right here, right now

[Verse 2]
high voice singing, then I drop to the low
kid comuter voces, watch the pattern go
Russian rap bounce with the quick quick glide
one-two step and I switch that side

I don't need a crown, I just need the room
everybody moving when I say that tune
rappal.app in the back of my grin
pal dot dance, let the whole thing spin

[Pre-Chorus]
songpal.ai, call my name
one more swing and we all play the game
sing everywhere, let it travel far
from the mouth to the hands to the car

[Chorus]
pal rap back
pal rap back
pal rap back
we go clap and bounce

sing pal dot a i
sing pal dot a i
sing pal dot a i
right here, right now

[Bridge]
ah, pal
say it again
ah, pal
bring your friends

[Chorus]
pal rap back
pal rap back
pal rap back
we go clap and bounce

sing pal dot a i
sing pal dot a i
sing pal dot a i
right here, right now
